purpose: Documentation of the bundled model contract; Java enforces this contract in YoloOnnxDetector, not by loading this JSON.
evidence: Measured bundled ONNX graph input/output and decoded grid operations

input.resize: aspect-preserving bilinear, dimensions truncated toward zero, minimum 1 pixel
input.resize_parity_note: Java uses Graphics2D bilinear/ImageIO, not pixel-identical OpenCV resize/JPEG decoding

postprocess.reject: non-finite values, invalid probabilities, non-positive dimensions, boxes wholly outside resized image content
postprocess.box_clipping: none; preserve center and extent for intersecting edge boxes

limitations: Only this single-class decoded YOLOX layout is supported; filename aliases must share this contract and other models need an explicit adapter.
The existing service still estimates entry points and target circle heuristically; results require manual review.
No detection is not a miss/zero score. A failed dedicated model does not silently fall back to dark spots.
The SHA256 records the evaluated artifact; runtime shape validation does not verify this hash or prove identical model semantics.
